# Generated Oracle PL/SQL parser — do not edit

`PlSqlLexer.ts`, `PlSqlParser.ts` and `PlSqlParserListener.ts` are generated by
[antlr-ng](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antlr-ng) 1.0.10 for the
[antlr4ng](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antlr4ng) runtime from the grammars in
`../grammar/`. Regenerate with:

```sh
cd gitnexus && node scripts/generate-plsql-parser.mjs
```

| Input                         | Source                                                                                         | License    |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| `../grammar/PlSql*.g4`        | [antlr/grammars-v4](https://github.com/antlr/grammars-v4/tree/master/sql/plsql) `sql/plsql` at `2766c2eed04f285dc763617c9459650892fcf5b9` (2026-10-28) | Apache-2.0 |
| `PlSqlLexerBase.ts`, `PlSqlParserBase.ts` | same commit, `sql/plsql/Antlr4ng/` (hand-written base classes the grammar's actions call) | Apache-2.0 |

Lint and formatting skip this directory (`eslint.config.mjs`, `.prettierignore`).
Do not patch generated files; fix the grammar upstream or in `../grammar/` and regenerate.
